description: Retrieve the full WIPO Pearl database record for one concept_id (from pearl_search_terms): validated term equivalents grouped by language, each with a reliability rating, a defining context, a usage note, and its source. Example: pearl_concept({ concept_id: "8818607" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Pipeworx supplies a WIPO Business Partner Portal credential automatically. Pass your own as JSON: '{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."}' to use a dedicated subscription instead.

concept_id.description: The record id returned by pearl_search_terms, e.g. "8818607".

lang_code.description: Optional: restrict the record to one ISO 639-1 language (AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH).

name: pearl_concept
title: Pearl Concept
